title: .config/ianf-product-map.toml, version 1
description: What product-map reads to build an app's product map. It reads this file as it is in the worktree it's given. See product-map's README.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

adapter.description: How the app's code is laid out: one of product-map's adapters.

source.description: The app's code, from the repository's root.

static.description: The app's public scripts, from the repository's root, if it has any.

out.description: Where the map and its descriptions are kept, from the repository's root.
